title: Improve: your best model plans, your cheapest model builds
description:
Using your most capable model for every task burns budget on work that doesn't need it. Improve from shadcn splits the job intelligently. The expensive frontier model audits your codebase and writes detailed execution plans. The cheaper, faster models carry those plans out. Frontier-quality direction at a fraction of the token cost. The senior architect thinks. The junior developers type.  #github #opensource
